description: 适用于活体动物研究；检查方法与结果，并提示伦理、实验设计和 Essential 10。
descriptionEn: For in-vivo animal research; checks Methods and Results and flags ethics, experimental design, and the Essential 10.

rules.message: 动物研究需要可识别且足够详细的方法章节。
rules.messageEn: Animal research needs an identifiable and sufficiently detailed Methods section.

rules.message: 动物研究需要可识别的结果章节。
rules.messageEn: Animal research needs an identifiable Results section.

rules.message: 请确认动物伦理批准、许可和福利相关信息已经说明。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that animal ethics approval, licenses, and welfare information are reported.

rules.message: 请逐项核对 ARRIVE 2.0 Essential 10 和 Recommended Set。
rules.messageEn: Check the ARRIVE 2.0 Essential 10 and Recommended Set item by item.
